load_tracker_existing_ids: load existing document IDs from the HuggingFace Hub tracker dataset
save_tracker_document_ids: save a set of document IDs to the HuggingFace Hub tracker dataset
load_tracker_fresh_start: load the tracker and start fresh with an empty set if it does not exist
save_tracker_incremental_update: save updated document IDs to enable incremental Meilisearch indexing
load_tracker_with_token: load the tracker using an explicit HuggingFace token or HF_TOKEN environment variable
